title: Honey Cookies
hookLine: Global-inspired honey cookies with 3 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Honey Cookies
steps.instructionTemplate: Dissolve honey into water. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches. Incorporate {m53579_1}, {m53579_2}, and {m53579_3} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure honey first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Honey Cookies
steps.instructionTemplate: Add flour. Let set a few minutes. Knead the mixture for a short time. Using a teaspoon, form the dough into round buns/cakes and place on the greased or baking paper-lined oven plate.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Honey Cookies
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake at 200 C for 10-15 minutes. Let Honey Cookies cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 12 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Honey Cookies to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 12 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 26 mins!
